title: Streamlord inspector variables
description: Values for {{baseUrl}}, {{signals}}, {{headers}} and the params of a route in Stream Inspector requests. Meant for local hosts, tokens and test values: keep this file out of version control.

baseUrl.description: The value of {{baseUrl}}, such as http://127.0.0.1:8081. Without it, the default base URL in the settings is used.

signals.description: The value of {{signals}} in the signals field, as written here.

headers.description: The value of {{headers}} in the headers field: one Name: value line per entry.

params.description: The value of each {{name}} in the URL and the headers, such as the request parameters Open in Stream Inspector writes for a route. Encoded in the URL, as written in the headers.
